description: Third round: ne with fast math off, r6k max with fast math off (control), NaN test on BF16 bits.
argv: import os, subprocess, sys; codes = [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/bench_relu3.py'])]; env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='/b' + os.pathsep + os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH', '')); RUNS = [('indexer=/b/indexer_ne_precise.py', 'indexer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py'), ('indexer=/b/indexer_r6k_precise.py', 'indexer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py'), ('indexer=/b/indexer_bits16.py', 'indexer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py')]; codes += [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--noconftest', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-p', 'swap_plugin', '-rfEPxX', '-k', k, path], env=dict(env, SWAP=swap)) for swap, k, path in RUNS]; print('exit codes (bench, ne_precise, r6k_precise (expected to fail the NaN contract), bits16)', codes); sys.exit(max(codes))
